newsitem.title: USA: Big Entertainment sees first profit in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Big Entertainment sees first profit in Q2.

text.p: BIG Entertainment said Friday it expects a profit in the second quarter in the range of $0.03 to $0.07 per share compared to a loss in the year-ago period of $0.24 per share.
The company said the profit is the result of a "significant" increase in revenues in its licensing division, and continued growth in its retail and book packaging businesses.
The company said the second quarter profit is its first ever, and is the direct result of investments it has made in developing its entertainment properties for licensing.

BIG said preliminary results shows its company-wide revenue increased to more than $3 million for the second quarter of 1997, representing an increase of more than 60 percent from revenues of $1.9 million for the corresponding period of 1996.

BIG Entertainment owns exclusive rights to certain entertainment properties created by a number of authors and media celebrities, including Tom Clancy, Leonard Nimoy, Gene Roddenberry, Isaac Asimov and Mickey Spillane.
